scope: Owned filesystem media preparation only; no queue/storage/DB orchestration or ready transition

implementation.architecture: VideoMediaModule exports VideoMediaService with typed config. Separate native filesystem adapter, subprocess adapter and pure unknown-input probe normalization. No HTTP/API module or production worker activation. No packages or container definitions changed.
implementation.workspace: Exclusive mkdtemp attempt directories under configured absolute temp root; fixed original.mp4/playback.mp4/thumbnail.jpg. Immutable object identity ownership prevents forged paths; lstat rejects symlink input/directory. Cleanup removes only owned directory and is idempotent. Active preparation blocks concurrent cleanup/reprepare. Success retains files for later upload; caller explicitly cleans in finally. Failure/cancellation cleans after awaiting child close.
implementation.disk: statfs bigint compares actual free bytes against original+remux plus named16MiB reserve before download; source byte count checked before preparation and space rechecked for remux+reserve. Expected bytes integer1..10GB only. Checks do not reserve disk or prove full10GB performance.
implementation.subprocess: spawn fixed ffmpeg/ffprobe names, shell:false, stdin ignored. FFmpeg additionally -nostdin; installed ffprobe5.1 rejects that flag so uses ignored stdin only. File/pipe protocol whitelist, forced mov demuxer, enable_drefs0/use_absolute_path0, fixed owned paths, no user filename arguments. Configured thread limit applied to probe/input/output and JPEG filter threads.
implementation.bounds: JSON stdout capped by configured max1MiB; FFmpeg file-only commands cap stdout at1byte. Stderr drained with zero retention/no logs, so no unbounded buffer or diagnostic exposure. Probe timeout and total-operation deadline; signal listener/timers cleared. Cancellation sends SIGTERM, escalates SIGKILL after250ms and waits close before settlement/cleanup.
implementation.metadata: Unknown JSON validated structurally; accepts ISO MP4 brands with one H264 video and optional AAC audio, positive finite duration/integer dimensions, optional finite rational frameRate. Returns only container/videoCodec/audioCodec/width/height/frameRate plus separate duration. Unknown metadata/tags never persist. QuickTime and codecs outside support rejected.
implementation.outputs: Remux maps video plus optional AAC, -c copy -movflags +faststart without recoding/HLS. One JPEG from first valid frame, explicit mjpeg/image2. Verify regular nonempty output files. Integration proves trailing-moov input becomes moov-before-mdat and identical encoded video packet hash, and JPEG really decodes.
implementation.errors: Typed INVALID_VIDEO_CONTENT, UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO_FORMAT, PROCESSING_TIMEOUT and safe PROCESSING_FAILED. Distinct VideoMediaCancelledError for lease-loss/caller cancellation, not a terminal media error. Unknown operational error sanitized; raw stdout/stderr/paths not in public error messages. No ready transition here.
